To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
materiality, agency and discourse are constitutive elements of organization.
The material, the social and the discursive are intertwined and interdependent in the constitution of organization.

the use of materiality and discourse in the constitution of organization is not only a question of the materiality and discourse of the organization but also of the materiality of discourse, the materiality of organization, and the materiality and organization of discourse.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the ways in which the material, the social and the discursive are interwoven in the constitution of organization.
how the material and the social are interwoven in the constitution of organization, how they are constituted as such, and how this interweaving and constitution is achieved through discourse.
how materiality, agency and discourse are implicated in the constitution of organization and how this constitution is organized.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

organization studies have moved from a concern with organization as a social construct and a focus on organizational discourses to a more nuanced understanding of the materiality of organization and the role of materiality in the construction of organization.
the materiality, agency and discourse of the organization and its environment are in constant interaction and influence each other.
the materiality of organizations is not a simple matter of physical objects or artifacts, nor is it reducible to the materiality of discourse or textuality.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have tried to make sense of the materiality of organizations, the agency of organizations, and the discourse of organizations.
the materiality of organization is a matter of agency and discourse.
we have tried to make a contribution in three directions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the material world is not simply a passive backdrop to social interaction.
materiality, agency and discourse are not just three different things, but three aspects or facets of the same thing: the constitution of organization.
the materiality of organizing is not a given, but a contingent and dynamic achievement of actors and discourses.
